ideas.pitch: A real-time data science engine that analyzes QR code scan timestamps, team traversal paths, and bottleneck choke points across the campus to optimize survival strategies in a Hunger Games style hackathon.
ideas.problem_statement: Data Science track challenges within the Xtract 5.0 campus-wide treasure hunt and coding battle royale.
ideas.title: ArenaPulse DS: Campus Treasure Hunt Telemetry Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the exact operational constraints of the event itself, giving judges a meta-analytical tool built on real-time data from the physical-digital scavenger hunt.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline that predicts whether a competing team will successfully clear the Data Science -> Machine Learning -> NLP sequence or stall based on early checkpoint telemetry.
ideas.problem_statement: Machine Learning track challenges within the Xtract 5.0 sequential progression rule.
ideas.title: TributeSurvival ML: Predictive Attrition & Task Dropout Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors proven predictive tabular modeling success at previous hackathons while mapping directly onto the multi-track elimination format of DJS S4DS.

ideas.pitch: An NLP system designed to parse cryptic Hunger Games style clues found behind physical QR codes, automatically extracting intent, mapping entity relationships, and decoding hints.
ideas.problem_statement: NLP track challenges within the Xtract 5.0 physical-digital treasure hunt.
ideas.title: ArenaLingo NLP: Clue Extraction & Cipher Sentiment Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages text parsing and information extraction tailored specifically to the themed riddle format of the event's preliminary puzzle gates.

ideas.pitch: A high-speed computer vision pipeline built for the final OpenCV showdown, engineered to instantly detect, validate, and parse marker signals from live video streams.
ideas.problem_statement: OpenCV finale showdown following the completion of the Data Science, Machine Learning, and NLP tracks.
ideas.title: OpenCV Victor Vision: Automated Campus QR and Target Verification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the make-or-break final OpenCV hurdle that stands between competing teams and victory in the arena.

ideas.pitch: A synchronized dashboard tracking team progression across all concurrent tracks (Data Science, Machine Learning, NLP, and the OpenCV finale) with real-time analytics updates.
ideas.problem_statement: Concurrent multi-track progression management across the DJ Sanghvi College of Engineering campus arena.
ideas.title: HungerBoards: Live Multi-Track Arena Telemetry & Status HUD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an immediate, highly visual demo of all event metrics, which organizers and judges can interact with live during the closing ceremony.
